title: One Company Invented The Three-Digit Number That Runs Your Financial Life
description:
Educational purposes only. Not financial advice.

Before the FICO score, lenders each used their own inconsistent methods to judge borrowers. In 1989, the Fair Isaac Corporation launched a single standardized credit scoring model that the major credit bureaus adopted, giving lenders nationwide one common language for risk. That original model is the ancestor of the three-digit score that now shapes loan approvals, interest rates and even some rental applications.
